transport.note: Default TRANSPORT=usb speaks NDJSON over USB CDC (stdin/stdout). Set TRANSPORT=uart in config.py only when using an external USB-UART adapter.

pinPolicy.note: Board-agnostic defaults leave reserved/allowed empty. Pico profile lives in boards/raspberry-pi-pico/config.py and mirrors firmware/boards/raspberry-pi-pico.json.

notes: Host validation: node validate.js exercises software, reserved-pin, and fake-machine modes; node validate-pico.js exercises the Pico profile. sys.hello/sys.info advertise only runtime-supported capabilities. Failures use structured codes including INVALID_PIN, INVALID_PAYLOAD, UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY, BUS_ERROR, WATCH_TABLE_FULL, and UNSUPPORTED_ACTION. CircuitPython is not supported. Physical hardware is not verified.
